g.text: MPTUNNEL · independent links with QUIC impairment
TCP: 200 Mbps · QUIC: 200 Mbps · 70 ms transfer / 30 ms return · 40 s offered load
MPTUNNEL 0.5.0 · three TCP carriers and one QUIC carrier · one observation per direction
Amber: QUIC transfer rate 10 Mbps at 15–25 s. Gray: UDP blackhole at 30–33 s. Each transfer direction uses 70 ms / 30 ms return.
Guides are nominal; collector and probe clocks differ. UP includes confirmation settlement. No UP echo. Exact values: measurements.json.
